#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="BLM Audit Package Cover Page">

<img src="data:image/bmp;base64," class="Icon" /> BLM Audit Package Cover Page</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="BLM Audit Package Cover Page">

A cover page report for the [BLM Audit Package](../../BLM/BLM%20Compliance.md#AuditPackage) that displays information of each meter and, if applicable, BLM property details.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," style="width: 17;height: 17;" /> Available Configuration Options in Meter Editor:

- Print Customer Name
- Print Alternate Meter Number Instead of Meter Name
- Print Measurement Area



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="Icon" style="width: 15;height: 15;" /> Schedule Editor Group Name:

- BLM Audit Package Cover Page
- BLM Audit Package



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="Icon" style="width: 15;height: 15;" /> View Sample Reports:

- <a href="../../../Resources/PDFs/Report%20Examples/BLM%20Audit%20Package%20Cover%20Page.pdf" target="_blank">BLM Audit Package Cover Page</a>
- <a href="../../../Resources/PDFs/Report%20Examples/BLM%20Audit%20Package%20Cover%20page%20-%20not%20BLM.pdf" target="_blank">BLM Audit Package Cover Page - Non-BLM</a>
- <a href="../../../Resources/PDFs/Report%20Examples/BLM%20Audit%20Package%20Cover%20Page%20-%20not%20BLM%20with%20ME%20options.pdf" target="_blank">BLM Audit Package Cover Page - Non-BLM With ME Options</a>

</div>

#### <span id="BLM2"></span><a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="BLM FMP Tier">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />

<img src="data:image/bmp;base64," class="Icon" /> BLM FMP Tier</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="BLM FMP Tier">

Reports whether AO Tier Variance has been granted for a meter, its Current and Calculated FMP tier, calculated its average daily volume, and any errors FLOWCAL generates for calculation. This report is valid for gas meters that are designated as BLM property. This report enables user to review FMP tier information for multiple meters at once.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," style="width: 17;height: 17;" /> Data used in this report is available on the [BLM tab of the Meter Editor](../../Meters/Meter%20Editor/BLM%20Tab.md).



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="Icon" style="width: 15;height: 15;" /> If the meter is designated as a BLM property and hence has BLM identification fields provided in the Meter Editor BLM tab, BLM identification field values are displayed in the top right of the report.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="Icon" style="width: 15;height: 15;" /> Schedule Editor Group Name: BLM FMP Tier



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="Icon" style="width: 15;height: 15;" /> <a href="../../../Resources/PDFs/Report%20Examples/BLM%20FMP%20Tier%20Sample.pdf" target="_blank">View Sample Report</a>

</div>

#### <span id="BLM"></span><a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="BLM Gas Volume Statement">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />

<img src="data:image/bmp;base64," class="Icon" /> BLM Gas Volume Statement</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="BLM Gas Volume Statement">

Displays the hourly meter flow data for a month or day range, and daily meter flow data for a month range, per BLM specifications, with additional precision and extension.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="Icon" style="width: 15;height: 15;" /> If the meter is designated as a BLM property and hence has BLM identification fields provided in the Meter Editor BLM tab, BLM identification field values are displayed at the top of the report, between the report header and the company logo.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," style="width: 17;height: 17;" /> Available Configuration Options in Meter Editor: 

- Print Edit Reasons
- Print Alternate Meter Number Instead of Meter Name
- Print Volume at Optional Pressure Base
- Print Measurement Area



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="Icon" style="width: 15;height: 15;" /> Schedule Editor Group Name:

- BLM Gas Volume Statement - Daily
- BLM Gas Volume Statement - Hourly



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="Icon" style="width: 15;height: 15;" /> View Sample Reports:

- <a href="../../../Resources/PDFs/Report%20Examples/BLM%20GVS%20Daily%20with%20BLM%20ID%20Fields.pdf" target="_blank">BLM Gas Volume Statement - Daily, with BLM ID Fields</a>
- <a href="../../../Resources/PDFs/Report%20Examples/BLM%20GVS%20Hourly.pdf" target="_blank">BLM Gas Volume Statement - Hourly</a>
- <a href="../../../Resources/PDFs/Report%20Examples/BLM%20GVS%20Daily%20with%20BLM%20ID%20Fields%20-%20Original.pdf" target="_blank">BLM Gas Volume Statement - Original Revision</a>

</div>

#### <span id="Heating"></span><a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Heating Value Uncertainty">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />

<img src="data:image/bmp;base64," class="Icon" /> BLM Heating Value Uncertainty</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Heating Value Uncertainty">

This report compiles heating value variability and heating value uncertainty for all FMP tiers. This report is valid only for gas meters designated as BLM property.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="Icon" style="width: 15;height: 15;" /> FMP Number is set in the Meter Editor BLM tab.

[Exceptions 9021 - 9024](../../Exceptions/Exception%20Directory/9000/9000-9999.md) will be generated for meters with a heating value uncertainty that exceeds the specified threshold or that has not been calculated. These meters will display with "\<\<\<".

For additional information, see: [Heating Value Uncertainty Details](../../BLM/Heating%20Value%20Uncertainty%20Details.md)



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="Icon" style="width: 15;height: 15;" /> Scheduling Group Name: BLM Heating Value Uncertainty



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="Icon" style="width: 15;height: 15;" /> <a href="../../../Resources/PDFs/Report%20Examples/HV%20Uncertainty.pdf" target="_blank">View Sample Report</a>

</div>

#### <span id="Heating2"></span><a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Heating Value Uncertainty Exceptions">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />

<img src="data:image/bmp;base64," class="Icon" /> BLM Heating Value Uncertainty Exceptions</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Heating Value Uncertainty Exceptions">

This report compiles exceptions for meters whose heating value uncertainties lie outside of their acceptable heating value uncertainty limits at the specified datetime. Meters for which heating value uncertainty at the specified datetime could not be calculated are also reported. This report is valid only for gas meters that are designated as BLM property, and only those meters with unacceptable heating value uncertainty levels and have heating value uncertainty exceptions generated are displayed.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="Icon" style="width: 15;height: 15;" /> FMP Number is set in the Meter Editor BLM tab.

For additional information, see:

- [Heating Value Uncertainty Details](../../BLM/Heating%20Value%20Uncertainty%20Details.md)
- [Exceptions 9021 - 9024](../../Exceptions/Exception%20Directory/9000/9000-9999.md)



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="Icon" style="width: 15;height: 15;" /> Schedule Editor Group Name: BLM Heating Value Uncertainty Exceptions



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="Icon" style="width: 15;height: 15;" /> <a href="../../../Resources/PDFs/Report%20Examples/HV%20Uncertainty%20Exceptions.pdf" target="_blank">View Sample Report</a>

</div>
